purpose: Turn deterministic Control Tower exceptions into human-governed, evidence-backed resolution cases.
primaryDecision: Understand, assign, evidence and human-resolve an exception without allowing AI to execute canonical state transitions.
guardrails: AI output is DRAFT_SUGGESTION and ADVISORY_ONLY
AI cannot acknowledge, assign, resolve, suppress or reopen
RESOLVE requires human actor, owner, root cause, evidence and resolution note
CRITICAL exceptions cannot be suppressed in alpha3
all alpha3 mutations remain localOnly=true and canonicalMutated=false
